text:
alex: FYI got EdgeGateway RFI — they want a POC, need KMS/HSM compatibility, throughput 1k reqs/s, quantized models support, and a pricing ladder for POC->prod.

marta: Thanks. Do we have a canned capability matrix for edge gateways? Might need a quick diff between Hosted/Dedicated/Private.

daniel: I can produce a trimmed matrix. For KMS: Private supports AWS KMS, CloudHSM v3+, GCP KMS. HSM via PKCS#11 integration — customers must bring HSM certs. I'll paste the snippet.

daniel: ```
Private: KMS: AWS KMS, CloudHSM v3/v4; HSM: PKCS#11, HSM vendors: Thales/Entrust; key rotation: supported
Dedicated: KMS: customer-managed keys via customer VPN to KMS; no direct HSM
Hosted: managed keys, bring-your-own-keys via Redwood KMS bridge
```

alex: Nice. EdgeGateway specifically asked for HSM attestations and FIPS 140-2 level. Can legal confirm if we can provide HSM attestation docs? @leo @sre-eng

leo: We have FIPS 140-2 evidence for our on-prem package; need redaction for customer-specific certs. I'll attach the summary PDF to the RFI packet.

marta: POC timeline: Edge wants 2-week POC with 3 models (embedding + chat + rerank). Need costs for POC (burstable Dedicated) and production estimate. @sales please advise.

alex: For POC estimate: we can offer 2-week Dedicated pilot discount 40% for capacity reservation + 50% credit on overage. Rough numbers: 4x A10G nodes ~ $12k/week list -> with discount $14.4k total. Need finance confirm. @fin

leo: Noted — finance check. Also clarify SLA expectations: POC is no SLA, prod needs 99.9% on Dedicated.

rfi-bot: Attachment uploaded: edgegateway_rfi_matrix.xlsx (s3://redwood-rfis/edgegateway/edgegateway_rfi_matrix.xlsx)

daniel: Can someone fetch network peering diagram? They asked about cross-account VPC peering + egress/ingress limits.

sre-eng: Pinged infra. Short answer: VPC peering supported for Private; Dedicated supports VPC endpoints + NAT egress with egress quotas configurable. I'll paste link to infra note: https://internal.redwood/ops/vpc-peering-guide

marta: Outstanding asks: 1) Confirm HSM attestation availability 2) Final POC pricing + discount terms 3) Sample runbook for POC ops 4) ETA for matrix answers (EOD tomorrow)

alex: I'll assemble answers and send final bundle to @sales for upload tomorrow AM. Any objections? :thumbsup:

leo: :thumbsup:

sre-eng: :thumbsup:

marta: assigning action items in doc — I'll create a short checklist and share.

alex: Thanks team — I'll produce the capability matrix diff and include the quant/latency tradeoffs per model.
